The consensus across the results is that the Museum of Fine Arts is closed on Mondays and open Tuesday to Sunday, 10:00 to 18:00, with last entry at 17:00. Several sources agree on this, including a 2026 guide that lists Monday as closed and Tuesday to Sunday at 10:00-18:00, with ticket desk and last entry at 17:00, and the Budapest Card listing, which shows Monday closed and Tuesday to Sunday at 10.00–18.00.

There are a few inconsistencies to be aware of:
- One 2026 guide says the second Friday of the month has extended hours, about 12:00 to 20:00, but I couldn't confirm this against the museum's own site.
- A ranking page says closed Monday and Tuesday, which conflicts with the majority of sources.
- An older listing mentions a Thursday late opening until 20:00, which doesn't match the current pattern and may be outdated.

Because individual halls can close for maintenance, and holiday hours vary, the results recommend checking the official site, szepmuveszeti.hu, before visiting. None of the results came from the museum's own site, so the holiday and special-day details should be treated as unverified.

content.text:
**下周一（2026年10月12日）去不了，布达佩斯美术馆周一闭馆。**

- 美术馆（Szépművészeti Múzeum，位于英雄广场）的常规开放时间是周二到周日 10:00–18:00，17:00 停止售票和入场，周一不开。好几个第三方来源都是这么写的，包括 Budapest Card 的官方合作页面。
- 如果你说的其实是城堡山上的匈牙利国家美术馆（Hungarian National Gallery），它周一也闭馆，所以哪一个都去不了。
- 10月12日不是匈牙利公众假期（国庆节是10月23日），按理不会临时加开。不过我没打开美术馆官网，没能确认有没有临时调整。

**建议：**改到周二（10月13日）或之后去。出发前可以在官网 [szepmuveszeti.hu](https://www.szepmuveszeti.hu) 再确认一下当天时间。有的展厅会临时维护关闭，节假日时间也可能不一样。

Sources:
- [Museum of Fine Arts – Budapest Card](https://budapest-cards.com/programs/museum-of-fine-arts)
- [Museum of Fine Arts Budapest: What to See in Two Hours – Hungary Unlocked](https://hungaryunlocked.com/museum-of-fine-arts-budapest-guide/)
- [Museum of Fine Arts Budapest – budapest.net](https://budapest.net/museum-of-fine-arts)
- [Hungarian National Gallery – The Better Vacation](https://thebettervacation.com/budapest/hungarian-national-gallery/)

VERDICT: CLOSED
